WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND r.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS per_day, c.ctrl_net, ss.net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS gap
FROM store_sales ss
FULL JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = coalesce(ss.store_id, td.store_id) AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctrl c ON c.store_id = cs.store_id
ORDER BY rank

SELECT 'sales' AS t, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx,
  sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n999, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), 0, 0, 0
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

SELECT r.business_date, d.is_trading_day, count(*) AS stores_with_rows, sum(r.net_sales) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN r.store_id=125 THEN r.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS kuopio
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND r.store_id<900
AND (NOT d.is_trading_day OR r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-13' AND DATE '2026-06-17')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
